decisions.statement: A stop ends what the seat dispatched before it ends the seat.
The report names what moved off a subagent before it names the stop.
The seat stopped is named by the first word.
A name no seat has a page for is answered apart from a word this command does not take.
A seat to stop is named as that seat's page is named.
Nothing here stops a seat by anything but the name its page carries.
A stop whose processes did not all end is refused rather than reported as done.
A stop refused after it wrote names each write that stop finished.
A stop refused before it wrote anything is refused as the fault alone.
A stop that threw rather than refused names each write that stop finished.
A stop that threw names those writes in the order that stop finished them.
A stop that threw carries the kind of fault the throw names.

definition: the command ending a seat's supervisor and taking the page that seat held
